entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker from Zendikar, blue and green, who venerates sea monsters and loses her spark in the Desparkening.

entities.name: Echoverse Kiora
entities.description: An alternate version of Kiora whose ancestors dwelled in Akoum's geothermal pools and who rides dragons and wields Akmon.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Kiora's home plane, ravaged by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Turi
entities.description: Kiora's younger sister, for whom she faced a serpent.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Aetheric parasites whose titans Ulamog and Kozilek devastate Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan destroyed by Chandra's flame at Zendikar.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan awakened by Ob Nixilis and destroyed with Ulamog.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Kiora raises a tsunami and is mistaken for Thassa's avatar.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A Theros polis struck by Kiora's tsunami.

entities.name: Tritons
entities.description: Theros's native merfolk, who believe Kiora is an avatar of Thassa.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The god of the sea on Theros, from whom Kiora steals Dekella.

entities.name: Dekella
entities.description: Thassa's magical bident, which greatly increases Kiora's control over the sea.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who sought Callaphe to reach the Temple of Mystery.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who sought Callaphe to reach the Temple of Mystery.

entities.name: Arixmethes
entities.description: A massive kraken on whom a city was built.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads the Liberation of Sea Gate and allies with Kiora.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A Zendikari city retaken from the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who raises hedrons around Ulamog.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who activates the hedrons and objects to Kiora's plan.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who burns the titans through Nissa and later disables the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who destroys the hedron network and awakens Kozilek.

entities.name: Lorthos
entities.description: A giant octopus summoned by Kiora and sliced in half by Kozilek.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A character who helps Kiora and warns of Ulamog.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The newly formed band of planeswalkers fighting the Eldrazi and later Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who invades Ravnica.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Bolas's artifact that traps planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker who tries to copy Kiora's bident with psychometry.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event after the New Phyrexian Invasion in which planeswalkers lose their sparks.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: A trickster figure of Kiora's childhood stories, whose Tricksters join her.

entities.name: Akmon
entities.description: The hammer of Purphoros wielded by Echoverse Kiora.

events.summary: A serpent swallows Kiora and Turi's exploration; Kiora distracts it, her spark ignites, and she promises Turi to return home.
events.quote: In that moment of boiling panic, her planeswalker's spark ignited.

events.summary: Kiora lands on Theros and calls a tsunami that devastates Meletis, and the Tritons take her for an avatar of Thassa.
events.quote: It struck the polis of Meletis and caused untold destruction

events.summary: Posing as the mariner Callaphe, Kiora is hired by Ajani and Elspeth to take them to the Temple of Mystery.
events.quote: One such facade she adopted was that of Callaphe

events.summary: Kiora leads them to Arixmethes, a kraken, and Thassa refuses to let Kiora take it while helping Elspeth and Ajani.
events.quote: a massive kraken upon whom a city had been built

events.summary: After a battle with sea monsters, Kiora escapes with Thassa's bident Dekella.
events.quote: Kiora escaped mostly unharmed and clutching Thassa's magical bident Dekella .

events.summary: Kiora arrives with merfolk and sea monster reinforcements for the Liberation of Sea Gate, meets Gideon, and they retake the city together.
events.quote: After 2 more days of fighting, they had retaken Sea Gate.

events.summary: Nissa and Jace trap Ulamog with the hedrons until Ob Nixilis destroys the network and awakens Kozilek.
events.quote: He destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

events.summary: Kozilek slices Lorthos in half and turns on Kiora, who is left wounded.
events.quote: the titan destroyed Lorthos by slicing it in half using its arm blades

events.summary: Jori En finds the wounded Kiora and they retrieve her bident.
events.quote: Jori En found the wounded Kiora amidst a mass of dead sea creatures.

events.summary: Kiora urges releasing the titans but Chandra burns them through Nissa's ley lines, destroying Ulamog and Kozilek; Kiora leaves alone.
events.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

events.summary: Kiora goes with the Gatewatch to Ravnica and is trapped by Bolas's Immortal Sun while fighting the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Dack Fayden touches Kiora's bident to copy it, and she catches him.
events.quote: She caught him, and the attempt made him look like he regretted his decision.

events.summary: Kiora stays on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun, then returns to Zendikar.
events.quote: opted to return to Zendikar instead

events.summary: As the New Phyrexian Invasion begins, Kiora returns to Zendikar to defend it and later loses her spark in the Great Desparkening.
events.quote: she lost her spark in the Great Desparkening .

events.summary: Kiora explores new seas across the Omenpaths but cannot find a route back to Zendikar.
events.quote: when she tried to find a route back to Zendikar, she was unable
